vpEntries.content: V. Glad you could make it. Lieutenant Mara Voss, NCPD. I've been going through your recent scanner reports. You've been rather busy. Some of your methods are... unconventional. Care to comment?
V. Glad you could make it. Lieutenant Mara Voss, NCPD. I've been going through your recent scanner reports. You've been rather busy. Some of your methods are... unconventional. Care to comment?
I wouldn't know. I'm no criminal.
I wouldn't know. I'm no criminal.

Of course not. Let's make sure the paperwork continues to reflect that. I'm investigating a man with connections to Arasaka. A contractor who helped make two witnesses disappear. I had enough evidence to bring him in. Unfortunately, the case was closed before my request for a warrant even reached a judge.

If anything, corruption's become rather more efficient. The people responsible know exactly which strings to pull. And who's holding the other end.

There even a single clean badge in this city?

A few of us, yes. Unfortunately, being honest doesn't make you particularly influential in this department. The contractor is carrying an encrypted data shard. Transaction records, names, dates. Enough to connect him to the disappearances. I need that shard, V. But there's something else. I need you to eliminate him. Permanently. This isn't an arrest. I'm asking you to do wet work.

But once it's over, I'll do everything in my power to make sure your name disappears from the incident report. I can't promise you a clean escape. Only that I'll do what I can afterward.
